cues.zhText: 正常状态下，藏在盲肠盲端的阑尾呈柔和粉白色，壁薄柔软，表面光滑。
cues.enText: Normally, tucked at the blind end of the cecum, the appendix is soft, thin-walled, smooth, and pale pink.

cues.zhText: 一旦发炎，阑尾壁迅速充血水肿而肿胀，浆膜面毛细血管像一张烧红的铁丝网爬满表面，整体转为暗红。
cues.enText: Once inflamed, the wall swells rapidly with congestion and edema; serosal capillaries spread like red-hot wire mesh, turning the appendix dark red.

cues.zhText: 炎症加剧后，肿胀的阑尾更粗硬，表面覆上一层灰黄色脓苔——这正是急性化脓性阑尾炎，又称急性蜂窝织性阑尾炎的外观特征。
cues.enText: As inflammation intensifies, the swollen appendix stiffens under a turbid gray-yellow purulent coat—the gross external appearance of acute suppurative, also called acute phlegmonous, appendicitis.

cues.zhText: 之所以呈现这一外观，是因为阑尾壁各层浸润大量中性粒细胞，使阑尾壁在肉眼下明显肿胀，外表面覆盖一层灰黄色脓苔。
cues.enText: This gross appearance arises because dense neutrophils infiltrate all layers of the appendiceal wall, causing visible swelling and a gray-yellow purulent coat on the surface.
